title: Animal species 'extinction crisis'
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why should ordinary people care if a species they never see becomes extinct?
Should limited conservation money focus on famous animals or on species that are most ecologically important?
How much responsibility do consumers have for extinction caused by farming, mining, or development?
Is it ever acceptable to give up on saving a species because the cost is too high?
What local species or habitat in your region do you think deserves more protection?
